arguments.text: Primary preprint arXiv:2404.01508v3 was read (local literature/source.json records URL/hash). It reports Mordell congruence identities leave six residues modulo840 and discusses a quadratic-residue obstruction to a fixed finite polynomial covering. This is a secondary account of Mordell, not an independently formalized theorem. The abstract still proposes an auxiliary conjecture, not an accepted proof of Erdos-Straus. The literature search has irrelevant results and is not an exhaustive current-status/novelty audit. We will not assume enough fixed congruences can close the original goal. First test the new auxiliary hypothesis that the first TWO possible denominators suffice for n=1 mod24; this is our exploratory strengthening, not a named published conjecture.

proposal.falsifier: A single n with certified obstructions for both denominators defeats the two-step route.
proposal.rationale: Adjust the route using actually read literature and state the new falsifiable subsidiary hypothesis.
